title: Pretty good fractional revival on single orbits of diamond-decorated cycles after transcendental diagonal perturbation
author: Drazen, Whitney; Kempton, Mark; Lippner, Gabor
work: Pretty good fractional revival via diagonal perturbation: theory and examples
difficulty_reason: The proof develops H-cospectral spectral blocks, proves irreducibility of their relative minimal polynomials under transcendental perturbation, and uses a Galois trace criterion with simultaneous Diophantine approximation. Explicit Fourier-block matrices for diamond-decorated cycles then establish distinct traces on every orbit.
